selection.vol_definition: stdev of 5-minute changes of YES price from CLOB /prices-history (interval=1d, fidelity=5), in cents
selection.share_definition: our quadratic Q / (competitor Q + our Q) at selection; per-minute reward share is also capped at 0.5 (assume others join)
selection.keyword_match: case-insensitive word-START match on slug (dashes->spaces) and question: regex \b<kw> so 'tariff' also matches 'tariffs'; deliberately over-excludes (e.g. 'war' matches 'warriors')
selection.refresh: re-select at start and every 60 min to fill empty slots; markets stopped for the day stay out until next UTC day
selection.event_exclusion_note: binary event questions resolvable by a single news item (release/launch/announce/attend, 'by <date>', 'before <date>', 'in/by <year>') are excluded in addition to v3 keywords

sizing.rule: shares = min(50, floor($5 / cost per share)), cost = bid price for the bid side, (1 - ask) for the ask side (buying NO); a fill that goes to zero loses at most $5. A side whose capped size is below the reward min_size is not quoted; markets where neither side can be quoted are skipped at selection.

risk.per_market_stop_scope: inventory PnL (excl. rewards) since UTC day start; cancel & stop quoting that market until next UTC day
risk.daily_stop_scope: sum of inventory PnL since UTC day start; stop all quoting until next UTC day
risk.cash_check: a side is quoted only if cash covers its full fill

inventory: flat: quote both sides at best bid/ask; after a fill, quote only the side that reduces net inventory (size = min(cap, |net|)); mark to mid every minute; settle at official resolution (Gamma closed=true outcomePrices)
fill_model: B = book-cross (next best ask <= our bid / best bid >= our ask) OR public trade (data-api /trades) printed at/through our level; full quoted size fills at our price
rewards: per minute: daily_rate/1440 * min(0.5, ourQ/(compQ+ourQ)), quadratic score size*((v-s)/v)^2, 1/3 rule for one-sided in [0.10,0.90]; booked as ESTIMATED, UNVERIFIED (not counted in stops or cash)
changes_vs_v2: pool <= $500/day (was 200), vol < 0.8c (was 0.6), volatility checked on top 300 ranked candidates (was 40), up to 15 markets (was 10). Everything else identical.
status: PREPARED, NOT FROZEN: set frozen_at_utc when the run starts
changes_vs_v3: hard $5 cost cap per side; event/announcement keyword stems and by/before-date regex exclusions; daily stop unchanged at -$10
